idea.title: What an AI listing video actually is
idea.angle: Many agents hear 'AI video' and picture fake houses. I explain it simply: AI takes your real listing photos and adds smooth, slow camera moves so they play like a short tour.
idea.hook: WHAT IS AN AI LISTING VIDEO, REALLY?

slides.heading: WHAT IS AN AI LISTING VIDEO, **REALLY**?
slides.body: No filming. No fake houses. Here's what it actually does.

slides.heading: "AI VIDEO" MEANS A **FAKE** HOUSE
slides.body: Many agents hear AI and picture rooms that don't exist. So they ignore it. And they skip the easiest video they could make.

slides.heading: IT STARTS WITH YOUR **REAL** PHOTOS
slides.body: AI takes the listing photos you already have. It adds smooth, slow camera moves. Your photos play like a short tour.

slides.heading: WHAT THE VIDEO **DOES**
bullets: Moves: slow camera moves across each photo.
Order: best shot first, then the main rooms.
Length: about 15 seconds.
Places: Reels, TikTok and WhatsApp Status.

slides.heading: NO FAKE ROOMS. NO FAKE **VIEWS**.
slides.body: It shouldn't add furniture, rooms or views. Make it look good, keep it honest. Buyers who feel misled don't come back.

slides.heading: HOW THE **15 SECONDS** WORK
bullets: 0–3 sec: your best shot with bold text.
3–12 sec: four or five of your best spaces.
12–15 sec: price, location and one clear action.

slides.heading: Real photos in. A short, honest tour out.
slides.body: No camera crew. No reshoot.

caption:
"AI video" doesn't mean a fake house. Here's what it really is.

It starts with the listing photos you already have.
AI adds smooth, slow camera moves, so they play like a short tour.
No filming. No added rooms, furniture or views. Just your real listing, moving.

idea.title: Hidden basics: why buyers don't bother asking
idea.angle: No location, no bedroom count, no price: people who have to ask for basics often don't bother. Showing the basics filters out time-wasters and brings serious buyers forward.
idea.hook: IF THEY HAVE TO ASK, THEY LEAVE

slides.heading: IF THEY HAVE TO ASK, THEY **LEAVE**
slides.body: Hiding the basics doesn't create mystery. It creates silence.

slides.heading: SAVING THE DETAILS FOR THE **DMS**
slides.body: No price. No location. No bedroom count. You hope buyers will message to ask. Most don't bother.

slides.heading: SILENCE, THEN "**HOW MUCH?**"
slides.body: Serious buyers scroll past. The few who message just want the price. Your day goes on chats that go nowhere.

slides.heading: SHOW THE **BASICS** UP FRONT
slides.body: A buyer should know in seconds if the home fits. Then the people who message are already interested.

slides.heading: WHAT EVERY POST **NEEDS**
bullets: Price: show it.
Location: the area, so they know if it works.
Size: bedrooms and bathrooms.
Type: for sale or for rent.

slides.heading: THE PRICE IS A **FILTER**
slides.body: I know showing it feels risky. But it filters out time-wasters. The people who message already know it fits.

slides.heading: SAME HOME. **NOTHING** HIDDEN.
slides.body:
Before: Lovely home for sale. DM for details and price.
After:
✓ 4 bedrooms · 3 bathrooms · for sale
✓ [Area, City]
✓ [Price]
✓ DM "TOUR" to book a viewing.

caption:
Buyers who have to ask for the basics usually just scroll on.

No price, no location, no bedroom count means silence.
Show the basics up front. The price filters out time-wasters.
The people who message you already know the home fits.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: 'DM for more info' is losing you buyers
idea.angle: A vague ask makes buyers think. Give one simple action, like a keyword ('DM TOUR') or a WhatsApp or DM link, and never three options at once.
idea.hook: "DM FOR MORE INFO" IS TOO WEAK

slides.heading: "DM FOR MORE INFO" IS TOO **WEAK**
slides.body: Interested buyers need one clear next step. Here's how to give it.

slides.heading: A VAGUE ASK MAKES BUYERS **THINK**
slides.body: More info about what? The price? A viewing? When buyers have to work out what to say, they often say nothing.

slides.heading: INTERESTED, BUT THEY NEVER **ACT**
slides.body: They liked the home. They maybe even saved the post. Then they scrolled on and forgot about it.

slides.heading: ONE KEYWORD. ONE **ACTION**.
slides.body: Tell buyers exactly what to send, and where. Make the next step so easy they don't have to think.

slides.heading: CLEAR ASKS THAT **WORK**
bullets: Keyword: DM "TOUR" to book a viewing.
Link: one WhatsApp link. Tap and chat.
Pick one: use it on every post.

slides.heading: NEVER GIVE **THREE** OPTIONS
slides.body: Call, DM or WhatsApp? Choices slow people down. Pick one action and stick with it.

slides.heading: SAME POST. **CLEARER** ASK.
slides.body:
Before: Call, WhatsApp or DM for more info.
After: DM "TOUR" to book a viewing.
✓ One word to send
✓ One place to send it
✓ They know what happens next

slides.heading: FIX THE **LAST LINE** OF EVERY POST

caption:
"DM for more info" sounds helpful. It quietly loses you buyers.

A vague ask makes buyers stop and think. Most won't.
Give one simple action, like DM "TOUR" or one WhatsApp link.
One keyword, one place. Never three options.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Out-of-town buyers can't visit. Video lets them look
idea.angle: Out-of-town and overseas buyers can't easily come to a viewing. A short, clear listing video lets them walk through the home from afar and decide if it's worth a trip.
idea.hook: YOUR BUYER LIVES ABROAD. NOW WHAT?

slides.heading: YOUR BUYER LIVES **ABROAD**. NOW WHAT?
slides.body: They can't easily come to a viewing. A short video lets them look anyway.

slides.heading: PHOTOS DON'T SHOW HOW IT **FLOWS**
slides.body: From far away, buyers can't picture the home. How do the rooms connect? How big is it really? So they don't make the trip.

slides.heading: LET THEM **WALK THROUGH** FROM AFAR
slides.body: A short, clear listing video works like a quick tour. They see the home in order, then decide if it's worth a trip.

slides.heading: LEAD WITH THE **BEST** SHOT
slides.body: The first three seconds. Your hero shot with bold text, like "4-bed with pool, quiet street."

slides.heading: WALK THROUGH IN **ORDER**
slides.body: Living room, kitchen, master bedroom. Smooth, slow moves, two to three seconds each. Now they can picture the layout.

slides.heading: END WITH ONE **ACTION**
slides.body: Price, location and one clear ask, like DM "TOUR". Then reply fast. Buyers abroad still message other agents.

slides.heading: They can't check in person, so keep it honest.
slides.body: Nothing added. Nothing fake.

caption:
Your buyer lives in another city, or another country. Can they still picture the home?

Photos alone leave far-away buyers guessing.
A short, clear listing video works like a quick tour.
They see the home in order and decide if it's worth a trip.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.

idea.title: Use one keyword per listing (TOUR1, TOUR2)
idea.angle: When every post says 'DM me', you can't tell which listing a message is about. Give each listing its own keyword so you know what's working and reply faster.
idea.hook: ONE KEYWORD PER LISTING. HERE'S WHY.

slides.heading: ONE KEYWORD PER LISTING. HERE'S **WHY**.
slides.body: Know which home each message is about, and reply faster.

slides.heading: "IS IT STILL **AVAILABLE**?"
slides.body: You have five listings live. Every post says DM me. Then a message comes in. Which home do they mean?

slides.heading: MORE CHATS. SLOWER **REPLIES**.
slides.body: You ask which one. They wait. A buyer who waits hours has usually messaged three other agents by then.

slides.heading: GIVE EACH LISTING ITS OWN **WORD**
slides.body: One keyword per listing, like TOUR1 and TOUR2. When TOUR2 comes in, you know the home before you open the chat.

slides.heading: PICK A SIMPLE **KEYWORD**
slides.body: Short and easy to type. TOUR1, TOUR2, TOUR3. One for each listing.

slides.heading: PUT IT IN THE **LAST LINE**
slides.body: Line five of your caption is the one action: DM "TOUR2" to book a viewing. One keyword, never three options.

slides.heading: **COUNT** WHAT COMES IN
slides.body: Note how many times each keyword arrives. After a month, you'll see which style of post brings real buyers.

caption:
"Is it still available?" Which one? If every post says "DM me", you can't tell.

Give each listing its own keyword, like TOUR1 and TOUR2.
You know the home before you open the chat, so you reply faster.
And after a month, you'll see which posts bring real buyers.

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
